The findings sum to +0.5 on their own sizes; the scaled number is smaller because the lean rests on inference, not a company-level Q1 number.

findings.finding: The FY27 plan needs only Q4 FY26's exit run-rate. Q4 FY26 standalone OP was 633m (Q3 684m) against a plan average of 627m a quarter. CA headcount runs from 112 toward 140, and the company told FISCO it set the unit price (237万 in the Q4 exit month vs 200万 a year earlier) conservatively. So Q1 OP progress near or above 25% is the likelier outcome, and a held-or-beaten plan is the relief case on a 9.6x PER.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Only two prior prints since the 2026-02-27 IPO. Q3 (2026-04-13 16:00, no earnings revision, commemorative dividend) moved +3.49% the next session; FY (2026-07-14 16:00, plan beaten, dividend raised, payout to 40%) moved +4.11% next session (yahoo chart). No Q1 print has happened before.
findings.why_not_priced: There is no IFIS consensus and no Q1 FY26 standalone comparative, so nobody has published a Q1 number for the market to anchor on. The stock trades at 9.6x plan EPS with a 4.2% yield, below the 1,900 IPO price. If the market believed the plan was a floor, it would not price the stock at single-digit PER while the company guides +16% OP. Partly priced: the run-rate arithmetic is computable from public 短信.
findings.independence: The quarterly OP split (Q3 684, Q4 633, H1 839) comes from kabutan's finance page, https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=505A, built from the company's 短信. That is the same underlying company disclosure, so it counts once.

findings.finding: doda's August 2026 report puts the job-openings ratio at 2.86x (+0.44pt YoY), with openings +18.7% YoY and job seekers flat (+0.3% YoY). June 2026 IT・通信 engineer openings rose 5.2% MoM, the largest gain of any occupation. Demand for Geekly's placements stayed strong through its Q1 (Jun-Aug), while candidate supply, its stated bottleneck, was flat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: none observed; macro series have not been tied to a Geekly print
findings.why_not_priced: This is a public monthly series and only a proxy; macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis. It is sized small for that reason, and filed because it covers exactly the Jun-Aug quarter being reported.
findings.independence: doda June 2026 report (IT engineer openings +5.2% MoM): https://doda.jp/guide/kyujin_bairitsu/2026/07.html. JAC Recruitment H1 ordinary profit +14% (2026-08-12): https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2124

findings.finding: HR-sector sentiment soured into the print. Dip (2379) cut its FY guidance on 10-13 after the close, citing competition (operating result now -2.5bn to +2.5bn against 5-10bn before), and fell to a 5-month low on 10-14. Visional's FY27 OP guide (+8.3%) came in below the >28bn consensus on 2026-09-10 and the stock fell sharply.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Geekly moved -0.44% intraday on 10-14 against dip's slide (yahoo chart). That is a weak read-through, because dip's cut is in job-ad media and Visional's in HRMOS investment, not IT agency placement.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: both items were public before the print, and the segments differ. Filed because a weak sector tape is the setup in which an in-line Q1 gets sold.
findings.independence: Visional guide miss: https://kabutan.jp/news/marketnews/?b=n202609110456 (2026-09-11). The two items are different companies and different documents.

findings.finding: Leveraged retail is building long into the print: the margin long balance rose from 100.7k to 131.2k shares between 9/18 and 10/9, and no margin short side exists (buy-only 制度信用). A disappointing progress rate has ready sellers and there is no squeeze fuel.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no history of a margin-overhang reaction on this name. Ahead of the 2026-07-14 print the stock ran up 11% on 07-07 and still rose 4.1% after the release.
findings.why_not_priced: The balance is public weekly data, and 131k shares is about 1% of shares outstanding: a modest overhang, which is why this is sized small.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive, consistent with the tiny +0.05 priced lean and the flat 20-day run-up. The strongest positive the release could carry is an early upward revision or a progress rate above 25% on the conservative unit-price plan. I looked for a pre-filed revision and found none; no buyback or dividend change is expected.
